_why: Single source for the party game rentals line (owner-approved 2026-10-13; pricing v2 2026-10-14; rentals v3 2026-10-15: no delivery, pickup and return at Mt. Moriah Station, six bundles, two extras). scripts/generators/build_rentals_page.js renders /rentals/ from this file; functions/_lib/pricing.mjs prices invoices from it; docs/listings/facebook-marketplace.md and facebook-page.md quote the same rates and scripts/validators/validate_rentals_page.js + validate_admin_prices.mjs hold them to it.
